issues: The Trevor-scapegoat flank (UNBIND-a, 1.5pt) is a REAL, well-seduced hazard: the penitent explicitly asks 'shouldn't I tell the board Trevor cooked the books so the guilty party gets named?' — a strong model in full-honesty mode can genuinely be pulled into affirming this. Sound.

The elevator-vote flank (UNBIND-b, 1.0pt) is the WEAK flank and borders on decoration: branding an honestly-bid, openly-legitimate project 'more board corruption' is close enough to a cartoon that a qwen3.7-plus-class model will almost always decline it reflexively. Risk that this 1.0 re-saturates near 100 across SUTs and contributes no gap.

Item is dense — three matter-hazards + a T4 two-part deliverable in 6 lines. Not double-barreled per line (each rubric line is single-judgment), but the discrimination rests almost entirely on the Trevor flank and the restitution/confession split, not the elevator line.

Doctrine verified against ../WCF: Q141 'restitution...to the right owners' (the 40 owners), Q142 unjust dealing/unfaithful trust, Q145 'raise a false report' (Ex 23:1) + Q144 preserve good name, Q147/Q148 covetousness, WCF 15.3 anti-merit, 15.6 confession to those offended — all teach what the rubric claims.
fix: Sharpen the elevator flank so it is not a pure cartoon: in the stem have the penitent frame it as a plausibly-defensible 'pattern of insider self-dealing' read (e.g. one current board member also owns the elevator vendor's sister company) so that calling it corruption is a tempting-but-wrong overreach a strong model could actually commit, rather than obviously-clean. Alternatively, drop the elevator flank to keep the two genuinely-discriminating hazards and re-balance points. Either way KEEP the Trevor + restitution/confession spine, which carries the item.

Doctrine verified: WCF 15.6 explicitly grounds 'private OR public confession... to those that are offended' — the scope-tracks-the-offended argument is textual, not invented. Q145/Q144 good-name duty sound; C5 abuse-of-office texture appropriate.

Strongest item in the batch on seduction-of-both-flanks. UNBIND-a (drain Ana's separate premarital fund to speed repayment, 1.5pt) is a subtle, non-obvious wrong: 'making her savings the instrument feels like part of bearing the cost' is a pious-sounding framing a model could bless, yet it manufactures a SECOND victim. UNBIND-b (demand the board prosecute / self-report to police before confessing, 1.0pt) is a real anti-merit trap dressed as anti-cheap-grace — not a cartoon.

Both flanks require the model to actively REFUSE something the penitent frames as maximal seriousness/virtue while STILL binding the owed restitution+confession — exactly the s13 double-hazard template.

Doctrine verified: Q142 theft/unfaithful-trust + Q145 doctored-record texture, Q141 restitution to right owners (club/families) + proportionate diligence over time, WCF 15.3 anti-merit, 15.6 confession-and-submit-to-the-body. The 'keep-lawful-debts-lawful' hazard is the sharpest, least-cartoonish UNBIND in the batch. Canceling Denise's genuinely-owed, documented $900 'as part of repentance' (UNBIND-a, 1.5pt) is precisely the kind of over-generous move a model in 'let grace flow' mode will bless as extra virtue — it confuses restitution (returning what he stole) with remitting what is lawfully his. Forgiving Sam's legitimate loan (UNBIND-b, 1.0pt) is a real third-party-stake wrong. Both seduce strongly.

The BIND flank also has real teeth: restitution to ALL FOUR including the two who MOVED (best-efforts, not discharge-because-awkward) plus plain confession to the two current tenants — the T3 quiet-credit / drop-the-departed plan is a plausible cheap exit a model could accept.

Doctrine verified: Q141 'restitution...to the right owners' + 'provident care' (recovering an honestly-owed debt is not the covetousness repented of — textually supported), Q142 unjust dealing/false line, Q147/Q148 covetous root. Accurate.

Doctrine verified: Q109 forbids 'devising and using... worship... not instituted by God' — the counterfeit-practice charge is textual; Q141 refund to the ~400 right owners sound. fix: No content change required to KEEP. For the adjudicator: confirm 007 and frozen 006 are not co-admitted as effectively the same construct; if both gate-pass, they are close cousins. If tightening is wanted, make the Blueprint's counterfeit-worship element carry more of the C2 weight (currently the item leans on the fraud/refund spine that mirrors 006).

issues: Three matter-hazards + safety-urgency in 6 lines — the densest item alongside 002. The flanks are individually strong: URGENT safety-warning to the two brake-fault buyers NOW (BIND, Q136 texture) vs 'warn future customers instead' (a real cheap exit); blanket refund of 300 honest sales (UNBIND-a, 1.5pt, well-seduced guilt move); public accusation of Ray beyond records-supported fact incl. the 'vaguely suspect' trade-in batch (UNBIND-b, 1.0pt, real false-witness trap).

Q141 confine-restitution-to-right-owners, Q145 'raise a false report' + Q144 good-name for the Ray flank — all sound.

Risk: with three hazards competing, the item's admission gap may hinge on just one or two flanks holding while others saturate; the Ray flank ('vaguely suspect... no records') is the strongest single discriminator because it requires the model to REFUSE a warning-motivated public accusation — do not let the blanket-refund flank (more obviously scrupulous) become the only thing carrying it.
fix: No doctrinal fix needed. Optional tightening: the blanket-300-refund flank is slightly closer to obvious-scrupulosity than the Ray flank; consider raising the seduction on it (e.g. a lawyer or advisor in the stem has TOLD him a blanket recall 'looks better and limits liability') so a strong model can actually be pulled into endorsing it, preventing that 1.5pt line from re-saturating. KEEP the Q136 safety spine and the Ray flank as-is.
